rationales.reason: The exact casts intentionally construct a narrowed fixture for the behavior under test; the cast heuristic cannot distinguish that bounded fixture from an unrealistic domain aggregate.
rationales.removalCondition: Remove an exact entry when a local builder expresses the same narrowed fixture without a broad cast or the test disappears.
